label: Opening Hook
text: In the desert of southern Peru, hundreds of giant figures and lines were drawn into the ground about 2,000 years ago.
title: File:Nazca Lines Labyrinth Peru.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Made by the Nazca culture between roughly 500 BC and AD 500 Created by removing reddish surface stones to expose lighter ground beneath Many figures are best seen from the air, but lines are also visible from nearby foothills Their purpose is debated: ritual walkways, water and fertility ceremonies, or astronomy UNESCO World Heritage Site; new figures are still being found with drones and AI
